name: Phoenixmon
main_effect:
[On Play] [On Deletion] If your opponent has 3 or fewer security cards, delete 1 of their Digimon with the lowest DP. If they have 4 or more, trash the top card of their security stack.
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 red Digimon card with 5000 DP or less or 1 red Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
